components.name: Animate Keyframes

inputs.description: Camera keyframes (ordered list)

inputs.name: t
inputs.description: Master slider [0..1] for the whole storyboard

components.name: Duration Counter
components.description: A timer-based counter that increments from Start to End over Duration seconds. Click Play to run it, Pause to hold the current value and Play again to carry on; it stays at End when finished, and Play then runs it again from Start. Reset goes back to Start. The activate input still works: switching it on plays, switching it off pauses.

inputs.name: activate
inputs.description: Optional. Switching it on plays the counter, switching it off pauses it. The Play / Pause button does the same

inputs.name: start
inputs.description: Start number

inputs.name: end
inputs.description: End number (default = 1)

inputs.name: digits
inputs.description: Number of decimal places

inputs.name: totalDuration
inputs.description: Time duration in seconds

inputs.name: fps
inputs.description: Frames per second (default = 30)

components.name: Event Timeline
components.description:
Split a normalized t (0..1) into events. Each event has its own 0..1 output.
t can be master T, Design Option Timeline progress, or an event output of another Event Timeline.
duration (seconds) is only used to display and snap the timeline in seconds.
Drag bars to edit, +/- to add or remove events, hold Shift while dragging to disable snapping.

inputs.name: t
inputs.description: Normalized time parameter in [0,1]. One value, or a list (e.g. progress) picked by index. Null t -> all events output null.

inputs.name: duration
inputs.description: Optional. Seconds represented by t (e.g. totalDuration, or slotSeconds from Design Option Timeline). One value, or a list picked by index. Display only.

inputs.name: index
inputs.description: Item to pick when t / duration are lists. Default 0.

inputs.name: fps
inputs.description: Frames per second, used by 'Snap: Frame'.

outputs.name: domains
outputs.description: Domain of each event in the input t space [0,1]. Can feed Design Option Timeline domains.

outputs.name: eventSeconds
outputs.description: Length of each event in seconds (empty when duration is not connected). Feed it to a nested Event Timeline's duration.

components.name: Apply Design Option
components.description:
Show / hide design option layers in the Rhino document using the visibility list from Design Option Timeline.
Connect the SAME options input as Design Option Timeline. Click the button to switch it on or off. Original layer visibility is recorded when switched on and restored when switched off (right-click to change).

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Option layers. Use the same input as Design Option Timeline.

inputs.name: visibility
inputs.description: Visibility per option, from Design Option Timeline.

components.name: Design Option Timeline
components.description:
Map a normalized t (0..1) to design options stored on Rhino layers. Hard cut between options, with optional blank gaps.
Options input: ONE layer -> its direct sub layers become the options. TWO OR MORE layers -> each layer is one option.
This component does not modify the Rhino document. Use Apply Design Option to change layer visibility.

inputs.name: options
inputs.description: Option layers. One parent layer (its sub layers are the options) or a list of layer full paths / names.

inputs.name: t
inputs.description: Normalized time parameter in [0,1]

inputs.name: durations
inputs.description: Relative duration weights for each option in the sequence. If left empty, all options are equal length. Missing or non-positive values default to 1.0.

inputs.name: gap
inputs.description: Blank gap weight between options, in the same unit as durations. 0 = pure hard cut. Right-click to add a gap at the start / end.

inputs.name: sequence
inputs.description: Optional playback order as option indices, e.g. [0,1,0,2]. If left empty, options play once in order.

inputs.name: domains
inputs.description: Optional domains in t space [0,1], one per sequence item (e.g. Event Timeline domains). If provided, durations and gap are ignored: an option is visible while t is inside its domain, blank otherwise.

inputs.name: totalDuration
inputs.description: Optional. Total animation duration in seconds (same value as View Capture Driver). Enables slotSeconds.

outputs.name: visibility
outputs.description: Visibility per option. Connect to Apply Design Option.

outputs.name: progress
outputs.description: Progress per sequence item: 0 before its slot, 0..1 inside, 1 after. Use it to drive animations that belong to one option (e.g. arrows). Right-click 'Progress: Null Outside Slot' to output null instead of 0 / 1 outside the slot.

outputs.name: slotSeconds
outputs.description: Length of each sequence item in seconds (needs totalDuration). Pair with progress for Event Timeline duration.

outputs.name: index
outputs.description: Index of the visible option (-1 during a blank gap)

outputs.name: localT
outputs.description: Local t within the current option or gap [0..1]

outputs.name: name
outputs.description: Layer name of the visible option (empty during a blank gap)

outputs.name: slotDomains
outputs.description: Domain of each sequence item in t space [0,1].

outputs.name: layers
outputs.description: Full paths of the resolved option layers (for reference)

components.name: Mesh Outline Preview

inputs.name: width

components.name: FramesToVideo

MP4 (H.264) plays everywhere; MOV (ProRes 4444) keeps transparency for compositing in After Effects or Premiere. Click the button to start; click it again while encoding to cancel. ffmpeg must be installed: put it on PATH, next to the plugin, or set ffmpegPath.

inputs.name: folder
inputs.description: Folder that holds the frames (the path of View Capture Driver)

inputs.name: baseName
inputs.description: Base file name of the frames

inputs.name: frameRate
inputs.description: Frame rate of the sequence (the fps it was exported with) and of the video

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: 0 = MP4 (H.264, plays everywhere, no transparency), 1 = MOV (ProRes 4444, keeps transparency, large files). Right-click to pick

inputs.name: quality
inputs.description: MP4 only: CRF 0-51, lower is better and larger. 18 looks nearly lossless, 23 is ffmpeg's default

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Video width in pixels, height keeps the aspect ratio. 0 = original size

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Output path (default = {folder}\{baseName}.mp4 or .mov)

inputs.name: ffmpegPath
inputs.description: Path to ffmpeg.exe or its folder. Leave empty to search next to the plugin, PATH and winget installs. Run "where.exe ffmpeg" in a terminal to find it

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True when the file has been written

outputs.name: log
outputs.description: Last lines of the ffmpeg log

components.name: Join Clips
components.description: Join several exported frame sequences (one View Capture Driver folder per shot) into one video, with a cut or a transition (crossfade, fade through black, wipe ...) between each pair of clips. To blend two design options, export the same camera move once per option and join them with a crossfade. Clips with a different size are fitted into the size of the first clip with black bars. Click the button to start; click it again while encoding to cancel. Needs ffmpeg 4.3 or newer: put it on PATH, next to the plugin, or set ffmpegPath.

inputs.name: folders
inputs.description: Frame folders in playback order, one per clip (the path of each View Capture Driver export)

inputs.name: baseNames
inputs.description: Base file name of the frames: one value for all clips, or one per clip

inputs.name: frameRate
inputs.description: Frame rate of the sequences (the fps they were exported with) and of the video

inputs.name: transitions
inputs.description: Transition between clips: one value for all, or one per join (clip count - 1). 0 = cut, 1 = crossfade, 2 = fade through black, 3 = fade through white, 4 = dissolve, 5-8 = wipe left/right/up/down, 9-10 = slide left/right, 11-12 = circle open/close. Right-click to pick

inputs.name: transitionSeconds
inputs.description: Length of each transition in seconds: one value for all, or one per join. The clips overlap by this much, so the video gets shorter

inputs.name: fadeIn
inputs.description: Fade in from black at the start, in seconds (0 = none). Fades from transparent when the MOV keeps transparency

inputs.name: fadeOut
inputs.description: Fade out to black at the end, in seconds (0 = none). Fades to transparent when the MOV keeps transparency

inputs.name: format
inputs.description: 0 = MP4 (H.264, plays everywhere, no transparency), 1 = MOV (ProRes 4444, keeps transparency when every clip is PNG, large files). Right-click to pick

inputs.name: quality
inputs.description: MP4 only: CRF 0-51, lower is better and larger. 18 looks nearly lossless, 23 is ffmpeg's default

inputs.name: width
inputs.description: Video width in pixels, height keeps the aspect ratio of the first clip. 0 = size of the first clip

inputs.name: output
inputs.description: Output path (default = joined.mp4 or .mov next to the first folder)

inputs.name: ffmpegPath
inputs.description: Path to ffmpeg.exe or its folder. Leave empty to search next to the plugin, PATH and winget installs. Run "where.exe ffmpeg" in a terminal to find it

outputs.name: done
outputs.description: True when the file has been written

outputs.name: log
outputs.description: Last lines of the ffmpeg log

components.name: AssignMaterialsByLayers
components.description: Create Rhino RenderMaterials from layer colors, assign them to layers, and set objects to use material By Layer.

inputs.name: skipLayersName
inputs.description: Text list of layer-name tokens to skip. Any layer whose full path contains one of these strings will be ignored.

inputs.name: bake
inputs.description: Set to True to apply materials to layers

components.name: RandomlyAssignObjectToLayers
components.description: Randomly bake input geometries into generated Rhino layers with random layer colors. If the layers are already exist, it'll update. If not, it'll create new layers. Noted that, the layers will be named like baseLayerName01, baseLayerName02...

inputs.name: geometries
inputs.description: Geometries to bake into Rhino layers.

inputs.name: baseLayerName
inputs.description: Base layer name. Layers will be named like Base01, Base02, Base03...

inputs.name: layerCount
inputs.description: Number of layers to generate.

inputs.name: seedObjects
inputs.description: Random seed for assigning objects to layers.

inputs.name: seedColors
inputs.description: Random seed for generating layer colors.

inputs.name: bake
inputs.description: Set true to bake geometries into Rhino.

components.name: Domain Partition
components.description: divide a domain into equal segments and remap numbers into new sub-domains

inputs.name: vaule
inputs.description: Vaule to remap

inputs.name: domain
inputs.description: Base domain

inputs.name: count
inputs.description: Number of Segments
